title: Allotopic Expression of ND6 Restores Vision in a Mitochondrial Disease Model.
intervention: AAV2-ND6 allotopic gene therapy (codon-optimized AAV2 construct expressing ND6 with mitochondrial targeting sequence)

outcomes.name: visual function
outcomes.effect_text: restored visual function in ND6P25L mice

outcomes.name: disease progression
outcomes.effect_text: attenuated disease progression, mitigated retinal cellular deficiencies and optic nerve damage
